opening.argument: The offer is tied to a specific purchase: viewers are asked to sign up through the speaker’s HashFlare link and buy hashpower, with a five-percent cryptocurrency return held out in exchange. The description likewise says, “Get 5% cashback when purchasing a contract on HashFlare.” This is a purchase-linked return, not merely a favorable opinion about a token. The Internxt discussion is presented as a token review, including the speaker’s view that it may do well, while the Litecoin giveaway is framed as a future possibility whose amount remains undecided. Neither changes the central offer: a stated return connected to buying a HashFlare contract through the referral link.
